Scroll past the last line in the terminal. Values: disabled, last-line-with-content, last-line-in-middle, cursor-line. Always off on the alternate screen.
Keep the past-end offset sticky instead of draining it as new output arrives.
Scroll past the first scrollback line. Values: disabled, same-as-last-line, first-line-with-content, first-line-in-middle.
Pixel-granular scrollback navigation; snaps to the nearest row on idle.
Show the scrollbar only while the viewport is parked away from the live output; keep it hidden while the view just follows program output.
Animate SGR-blink (SGR 5/6) cells. Off renders them steady (accessibility). Alias: font-blink.
How bold cells resolve when no bold face exists. Values: off, auto, primary-only, synthetic. Alias: font-bold.
How italic cells resolve when no italic face exists. Values: off, auto, primary-only, synthetic. Alias: font-italic.
Render SGR-underline cells' underline decoration. Alias: font-underline.
Active theme (light slot). Overrides foreground, background, and palette. See Built-in Themes.
Theme used when the OS is in dark mode and auto-theme-dark-mode is on.
Let programs rename the tab and window with OSC 0/1/2. Turn off to pin every tab to what the rules below resolve.
Allow apps to query the window title (XTWINOPS). Off by default (security).

Initial rows (grid mode).
How initial window size is decided. remember restores the last size, frame uses pixel dimensions, grid uses cell counts.
Initial window width in pixels (frame mode).
Directory for a brand-new window's first pane. profile (Windows only; elsewhere same as home) uses the launch profile's cwd (empty -> home).

Windows only. DirectWrite rasterization. natural (default) is grayscale AA with grid-fitting; natural-symmetric is slightly softer; gdi is GDI-style hinting; cleartype is subpixel ClearType; aliased has no antialiasing. Ignored on other platforms.
Initial directory. inherit, home, or an absolute path (~/ allowed).
